title: The bird on the stone head in November
logline: The bird on the stone head's brow again, five months after the first time, in November rain, the chalk long gone, the plaque's hole grown over. The page checks on both things.

panels.composition: The moss-grown carved stone face in November rain with the small rainbow bird on its brow, the grass at its base grown over, the shingle wall wet.
